mapper.select: SELECT id, title, is_pinned AS pinned, user_id, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, del_flag FROM luck_chat_session WHERE del_flag = 0 ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, update_time DESC

SELECT id, title, is_pinned AS pinned, user_id, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, del_flag FROM luck_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, update_time DESC

SELECT id, title, is_pinned AS pinned, user_id, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, del_flag FROM luck_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, update_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM luck_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT id, title, is_pinned AS pinned, user_id, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, del_flag FROM luck_chat_session WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO luck_chat_session (id, title, is_pinned, user_id, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, del_flag) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{pinned}, #{userId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, #{delFlag})
mapper.update: UPDATE luck_chat_session SET update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE luck_chat_session SET is_pinned = #{pinned}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE luck_chat_session SET title = #{title}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE luck_chat_session SET del_flag = 1, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE luck_chat_session SET del_flag = 1, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
